# Collected Go source notices

This offline collection preserves notices from the fixed CLIProxyAPI module graph and the verified official Go 1.26.0 archive. Original license bytes are copied, with source module/version and SHA-256 recorded in manifest.json.

Only module roots and their license/licenses/legal directories are scanned; symbolic links are skipped. Missing module source, missing notice files, graph errors and scan issues remain explicit in the manifest. SPDX values remain NOASSERTION unless a source notice contains an explicit identifier.

The three binary dependency lists come from reading Go build information with go version -m; the binaries were not executed. A module-graph entry does not by itself prove that a module is linked into a binary.

This is a source notice inventory, not a declaration that all dependencies use MIT or that the collection establishes complete license compliance. No license is assigned to the wrapping service or the whole project.
